m.d: A cycle is a number of regular things that happen again and again.
m.e: Right now we are in an upward-moving part of the business cycle.

m.d: A cycle is a short way of saying bicycle or motorcycle.
If you cycle somewhere, you go there by bicycle or motorcycle.
m.e: The rain was falling harder than ever as I cycled home down the Banbury Road.

m.d: If you cycle a machine, you run it through one cycle.
m.e: The test will cycle the computer through ten start ups.

m.d: If someone is cynical, they have a negative attitude towards life.
m.e: He is a cynical person who seems to complain about everything.

m.d: Mixing of cybernetic and organism, a cyborg is a being, usually human, that has an important part of mechanical/robotic devices in his or her body.
A true robot that has a relation with organic life, such as looking like a normal human being or having a human soul inside.
A cylinder is a shape consisting of two circles connected to a tube.
m.e: Cans, pens, and flashlights are usually shaped like cylinders.

m.d: In mythology, a cyclops is a giant who only has one eye
Cyprus is a country in south-east Europe (sometimes treated as a part of West Asia).
A storm with air going around in a circle in the same direction as the Earth. If it's big, it might be called a hurricane or typhoon.
m.e: A cyclone blew part of the roof off the house.

m.d: A cynic is a person who is sarcastic and has a negative attitude.
